name: SDF Fusion
definition: Fuses depth and normal data into a Truncated Signed Distance Function (TSDF) volume and a weighted color volume by raycasting from camera to voxel centers, accumulating signed distances and colors via weighted averaging.
summary: SDF Fusion fuses multi-view depth and normal data into a TSDF volume, distinguished by its use in joint learning pipelines with SMPL body priors for 3D reconstruction.
